description:
Deliver addressed peer messages only to live children in the same group. Best effort, nonblocking.

## Background

No durable mailbox, no exactly-once, no wait-for-reply, no parked sessions. Send returns immediately. Live recipient: steer/followUp at a child-safe boundary (may postpone idle). Terminal: recipient-terminal. Do not reroute through the parent. Peer messages do not start a parent turn.

## Success criteria

- Same-group live delivery works.
- Cross-group and terminal fail clearly.
- Parent inspects via list_minions/show_minion, not a parent turn per peer message.

## Test plan

- Unit: ACL same group, identity from closure.
- Integration: live vs disposed.
- Size/depth limits fail mailbox-full.

## Considerations

Peer chat can delay settlement. Halt is the escape. No timeout product in V1.
title: Deliver nonblocking same-group messages to live children
